top_signals.title: Saudi Aramco Gives Full September Oil Allocations to 3 European Refiners
top_signals.summary: Saudi Aramco will supply full contractual crude volumes to at least three European refiners in September, offering deliveries from Egypt, Saudi Arabia and through ship-to-ship transfers off Malta as the war disrupts the kingdom’s normal export routes, Bloomberg reported on Wednesday via The Edge Malaysia. Two European refiners will take their barrels from Egypt’s Mediterranean port of Sidi Kerir, while a third can choose between Sidi Kerir, Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea port of Yanbu or a ship-to-ship transfer off Malta, Bloomberg reported…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Foreign visitors to Japan increased 0.1% in July
top_signals.summary: The uptick comes despite visitors from mainland China dropping 56.1% due to the Chinese government's advisory against travel to Japan.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Trump touted a deal to avert new tariffs on Canada. Here's what we know so far
top_signals.summary: Trump's new tariffs on about $20 billion worth of Canadian goods were set to take effect Wednesday, but were postponed by three days.

top_signals.title: Congress can still ‘land this plane’ on crypto bill as ethics talks stall, says Democratic Sen. Gallego
top_signals.summary: Sen. Ruben Gallego says Congress can still "land this plane," referring to the Clarity Act crypto bill, as concerns grow over an unfinished ethics deal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
